metadata.forecast: heuristic current belief plus historical causal rates
metadata.weather: causal sample at or before the decision time; session mean only when no trace exists
metadata.wetness: INFERRED from the Rainfall bool with assumed rain/drying coefficients; not a FastF1 measurement
metadata.tyre_state: modelled wear and temperature; tyre_life is OBSERVED AGE IN LAPS and is never wear
metadata.pit_context: team/synthetic plan when supplied, otherwise unknown -- no validated rival pit inference exists, and actual pit times are oracle-only
metadata.deployed_lap: point-estimate deployed store energy over the lap, MJ
metadata.deployed_lap_posterior_mean: posterior mean deployed store energy over the lap, MJ
metadata.usable_mean: current deployable store energy belief at sample time, MJ
